speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Every generation seeks to do better than the one before.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Besides improving employment outcomes, we want a more inclusive workforce, more progressive workplaces, and a greater sense of security in retirement.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Despite global disruptions to business models and employment arrangements, Singaporeans can distinguish ourselves by becoming an agile workforce that charts a bold path forward.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To have better jobs and higher incomes, our workers need businesses to transform.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To stay competitive and innovative, our businesses need workers to adapt.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We must maximise the benefits from technology and minimise the cost of dislocations.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To achieve good employment outcomes, we need business transformation and worker adaptation to be in sync with each other.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: As our society matures, we aspire for a more inclusive workforce that values seniors and working women and provides opportunities to persons with disabilities and ex-offenders.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Our workplaces must have more progressive human resource (HR) practices with strong emphasis on employee protection, engagement, safety and health.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Industrial relations must continue to be underpinned by mutual respect and fair play between employers and employees.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: This has been the cornerstone of Singapore’s unique brand of tripartism that has stood the test of time.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With longer life expectancy, we must continue to strengthen retirement adequacy.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We should enable Singaporeans to work as long as they wish to, whether through regular employment or participation in the emerging gig economy.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: To spur transformation, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) will work through economic agencies to provide selective flexibility in our foreign manpower policy to help businesses and industries meet short-term or emerging skills gaps.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will step up support for mid-career jobseekers and the long-term unemployed.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The enhanced Place-and-Train schemes and Professional Conversion Programmes will help more workers reskill and move into new occupations or sectors with progression.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The new Career Trial will enable more jobseekers to try out short-term work stints to facilitate their assessment of new jobs and careers.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also transform our employment services through technology.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The MyCareersFuture portal will make job searches more personalised, smarter and faster to better help jobseekers and employers find suitable matches.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Our foreign manpower policy will remain carefully calibrated to support our economic objectives while moderating social impact.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will continuously review the Fair Consideration Framework to secure the interests of working Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Singapore also has much to gain from our enterprises accessing global expertise.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through the Capability Transfer Programme, businesses can speed up the transfer of global expertise to strengthen their Singaporean Core.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will support businesses that are committed to building a complementary local-foreign workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The re-employment age was raised to 67 in July 2017.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With active ageing and improved health, we will work with the tripartite partners to enable more seniors to work longer.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through WorkPro, we will support employers to redesign jobs to make them easier, safer and smarter for seniors.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will actively promote the adoption of the Tripartite Standard on age-friendly workplace practices.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will work with the tripartite partners to enhance and extend PWM to more sectors to give more lower-wage workers better progression in jobs, skills and wages.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will support those with caregiving responsibilities, such as working mothers, to achieve both career and family aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: While our full-time employment rate for women ranks highly compared to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) countries, our female part-time employment rate is relatively low.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through the Work-Life Grant, we will support more employers to provide flexible working arrangements (FWAs) and help more companies adopt the Tripartite Standards on FWAs.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will support and fund employers to enhance the employment and employability of persons with disabilities through the Open Door Programme.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also work with the Singapore Corporation of Rehabilitative Enterprises (SCORE) to equip ex-offenders with relevant skills to reintegrate into the workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through the HR Industry Manpower Plan, we will strengthen the HR sector, uplift the HR profession and promote progressive HR practices.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also help good employers distinguish themselves through the Human Capital Partnership Programme.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will help to ensure safe and healthy workplaces.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Through the programme, injured workers can recover more quickly and resume work earlier.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Besides helping regular employees, we will support self-employed persons and freelancers, including those who engage in the emerging gig economy.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will help them by promoting fair contracting terms, making available prolonged medical leave insurance products, and developing competency frameworks for skills upgrading so that their choice of self-employment is a viable and sustainable career option.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Singaporeans can enjoy security in retirement through drawing on their CPF savings, discretionary savings, the support of their families, and monetising their housing assets.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will supplement this with digital services to help more Singaporeans plan and improve their financial well-being in retirement.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will provide more support for CPF members who top-up their own and their family members’ CPF, and enhance options to invest their savings for higher returns.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: These measures will further help members get higher retirement payouts.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will continue to help lower-income Singaporeans build up their retirement savings through the Workfare Income Supplement scheme and to supplement their retirement income through the Silver Support scheme.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also help self-employed persons make MediSave contributions in a convenient and timely manner.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Singapore's approach to tripartism sets a high bar.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We have consistently sought to be both pro-business and pro-worker in all that we do.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With every generation of leaders, the tripartite partnership must be refreshed.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MOM values the trust painstakingly built up over the years.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With tripartism as our bedrock, we will nurture an agile workforce that is future-ready.

speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: With trust as our foundation, we will forge ahead together with our tripartite partners to fulfill the shared vision of an inclusive workforce, progressive workplaces and secure retirement for all.
